skip-match.scope: Only omit the original full matches decision; remove now-unreachable Ok fallback and mark the borrowed input used so this stays a compiling intended wrong implementation.
skip-match.counterexample: same session and changed full capture: RecordReplyValues.original / changedCapture

clear-terminal.scope: Only clobber the full returned terminal payload after the unchanged successful matches guard.
clear-terminal.counterexample: normal complete matching receipt with terminal true: RecordReplyValues.original / terminalReceived

proof_policy: Wrong views import the unchanged Model/Values and existing Recorded proof, and exclude the correct RecordReplyCore/RecordReplyWitnesses.
